patch_description: Optimizing for trade frequency and quality to maximize the combined score. The previous high score of 80.50 was primarily driven by a higher trade count (462 trades vs the current 234). I am decreasing the entry threshold (base_thresh) and removing restrictive filters (RSI, funding) while retaining Order Book Imbalance (OBI) as a light high-quality filter. I am also standardizing the take_profit, stop_loss, and max_bars closer to the seed's high-performing fixed values (0.004/0.003/4) but with a subtle volatility adjustment to handle noisy environments.
